semantics: The block provides two decimal-output paths: an ASCII digit writer that converts text to a VDP tile word, and a numeric three-digit formatter that uses 100/10/1 divisors and VDP_WriteTileWord. The one-digit helper is an independent copy of the existing transition-screen decimal extractor.
conclusion: The former 0x001B044E-0x001B048F UNKNOWN block is a complete VDP decimal-output utility family; no owning caller or higher-level display label is asserted yet.
